services.title: Personal Injury
services.summary: Accidents, work injuries and wrongful death
services.text: If you have been injured, contact us right away. We help you through the legal process, protect you from the insurance companies, and charge no legal fees unless we win.
services.lead: When you are injured it is very important that you contact us immediately. Our representation will ensure that you take the steps necessary in your case and that you receive the maximum compensation for your injuries. We know being injured can be life changing, and dealing with doctors, medical bills, lost wages and other expenses is an additional burden and stress. Let us help you navigate the legal process and protect you from the insurance companies. We will not charge you legal fees for your case unless we win.

about.title: From a one-bedroom apartment in Pasadena to a law degree
text: Sintia Solis was born in Veracruz, Mexico, and soon after her parents moved to Tamaulipas, where the family built a home. Under the Immigration Act of 1990 they decided to immigrate permanently to the United States as a family, full of fears because they did not know the language or the culture, yet hopeful for a better life. They lived in a tiny one-bedroom apartment in a very low-income area of Pasadena, and Sintia started kindergarten without a speck of English.

Soon after high school, Sintia was a single mother. She started classes at a community college while working a full-time job, determined not to let her parents down after all the sacrifices they had made. After much hard work she graduated from the University of Houston Clear Lake, then worked as a realtor for a few years, though her heart and passion were always in the law.

When her sons were old enough to all go to school, she took the leap of faith and applied to law school. As a mother of three boys she ranked in the top ten percent of her class all three years and graduated Summa Cum Laude with honors. In law school she took immigration courses, was part of the criminal clinic, and won dismissals for clients as a student attorney.

Sintia is a proud mother of three wonderful sons and a pug, and the proud daughter of the most amazing and supportive parents. Her strong Christian faith is the foundation and strength that keeps her going every single day.
